parameters.query: SELECT e.id AS eid, e.status AS estatus, t.id AS tid, t.code AS tcode, t.name AS tname, t.status AS tstatus, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, (t.start_date <= DATE(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), '+00:00', '+05:30'))) AS started, tm.id AS team_id, tm.code AS team_code, tm.name AS team_name, d.name AS dname, d.min_age, d.max_age, d.squad_max, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entry_players ep WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id) AS squad_count, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', x.id, 'name', au.name, 'phone', au.phone, 'age', TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, au.birthdate, t.start_date), 'role', x.role, 'position', x.position, 'jersey_name', COALESCE(x.jersey_name, au.jersey_name), 'jersey_number', COALESCE(x.jersey_number, au.jersey_number), 'jersey_size', au.jersey_size, 'status', x.status, 'in_squad', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entry_players ep WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id AND ep.team_member_id = x.id), 'joined', DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(x.joined_at, '+00:00', '+05:30'), '%e %b, %l:%i %p'))) FROM team_members x JOIN app_users au ON au.id = x.user_id WHERE x.team_id = tm.id AND x.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PENDING') AND x.role <> 'COACH') AS members, g.id AS tgt_id, g.status AS tgt_status, g.user_id AS tgt_user, gu.name AS tgt_name, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, gu.birthdate, t.start_date) AS tgt_age, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entry_players ep WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id AND ep.team_member_id = g.id) AS tgt_in_squad, (SELECT ot.name FROM tournament_entry_players ep JOIN tournament_entries oe ON oe.id = ep.entry_id JOIN teams ot ON ot.id = oe.team_id  WHERE ep.tournament_id = t.id AND ep.user_id = g.user_id AND oe.id <> e.id LIMIT 1) AS tgt_other_team FROM tournament_entries e JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = e.tournament_id JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = e.team_id LEFT JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = e.division_id LEFT JOIN team_members g ON g.id = $2 AND g.team_id = tm.id LEFT JOIN app_users gu ON gu.id = g.user_id WHERE e.manage_key_hash = $1 LIMIT 1
